# Office of Justice Programs

> > The Office of Justice Programs (OJP) is the federal government's primary source for criminal justice grants, statistics, research, and victim services, serving law enforcement agencies, courts, and communities nationwide.

OJP is a component of the Department of Justice that administers federal funding through multiple program bureaus including the Bureau of Justice Assistance (BJA), Bureau of Justice Statistics (BJS), National Institute of Justice (NIJ), Office for Victims of Crime (OVC), and Office of Juvenile Justice and Delinquency Prevention (OJJDP). The organization provides grants, research data, and evidence-based guidance to strengthen the criminal justice system.

- Federal funding and grants
- Criminal justice research
- Crime statistics and data

## Core Program Offices

- [Home | Office of Justice Programs](https://www.ojp.gov): OJP homepage: federal funding and research for justice system strengthening
- [About Us | Office of Justice Programs](https://www.ojp.gov/about): OJP organizational structure, mission, and program office overview
- [Home | Bureau of Justice Assistance](https://bja.ojp.gov): BJA homepage: grant administration and criminal justice policy for safer communities
- [Home | Bureau of Justice Statistics](https://bjs.ojp.gov): BJS: primary source for U.S. criminal justice statistics and data analysis
- [Home | National Institute of Justice](https://nij.ojp.gov): NIJ: criminal justice research, data archives, and forensic science resources
- [Home | Office for Victims of Crime](https://ovc.ojp.gov): OVC: victim services grants and Crime Victims Fund administration
- [Working for Youth Justice and Safety | Office of Juvenile Justice and Delinquency Prevention](https://ojjdp.ojp.gov): OJJDP: juvenile justice, youth delinquency prevention, and residential placement
- [Office of Sex Offender Sentencing, Monitoring, Apprehending, Registering, and Tracking](https://smart.ojp.gov): SMART Office: sex offender registration and SORNA implementation guidance

## Grants and Funding

- [Grants/Funding | Office of Justice Programs](https://www.ojp.gov/funding): OJP Funding Resource Center: solicitations, applications, and grantee instructions
- [Opportunities & Awards | Current Funding Opportunities | Office of Justice Programs](https://www.ojp.gov/funding/explore/current-funding-opportunities): Current OJP funding opportunities and application information
- [OJP Grant Application Resource Guide | Office of Justice Programs](https://www.ojp.gov/funding/apply/ojp-grant-application-resource-guide): Guide to OJP grant application process and JustGrants submission requirements
- [Recipient Resources | Overview | Office of Justice Programs](https://www.ojp.gov/funding/implement/overview): Post-award instructions, financial reporting, and grant management for recipients

## Publications and Resources

- [Publications | Office of Justice Programs](https://www.ojp.gov/news/publications): OJP reports and guidance including DOJ Grants Financial Guide
- [Multimedia | Office of Justice Programs](https://www.ojp.gov/library/multimedia/list): OJP videos and webinars on law enforcement, victim services, and grant budgeting

## News and Communications

- [Justice Programs News & Funding Newsletter | Office of Justice Programs](https://www.ojp.gov/news/justice-programs-news-funding): OJP newsletter: funding opportunities, events, news, and publications
- [News Releases | Office of Justice Programs](https://www.ojp.gov/news/news-releases): OJP news releases on criminal justice statistics and program activities
- [Speeches | Office of Justice Programs](https://www.ojp.gov/news/speeches): Transcripts of speeches from OJP leadership on justice programs

- [Media Inquiries | Office of Justice Programs](https://www.ojp.gov/news/for-media): OJP media contact information and journalist guidelines
